title: Duplicate Gateway
description:
A fictional lab IDS recorded repeated ARP claims on the internal network:

```
02:14:01 arp who-has 10.20.0.1 tell 10.20.0.66
02:14:01 arp reply 10.20.0.1 is-at de:ad:be:ef:00:66
02:14:04 arp reply 10.20.0.1 is-at de:ad:be:ef:00:66
02:14:09 arp reply 10.20.0.1 is-at de:ad:be:ef:00:66
```

The real gateway is 10.20.0.1 with MAC 00:11:22:33:44:55. A lab host is claiming the gateway address.
objective: Submit the source IP of the impersonating host as HC{ip}.

hints.text: Look at the 'tell' address in the who-has request and the suspicious replies.
The attacker is not the real gateway address.
